title: Irish Soda Bread Dumplings
description: A moist and savory twist on traditional Irish soda bread, in the form of comforting dumplings. This hearty dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Cut the soda bread into 2-inch cubes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, milk, and salt (if using).
Add the softened butter and grated cheddar cheese (if using). Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add the soda bread cubes and mix until the dough is evenly coated.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead until the dough comes together.
Use a cookie scoop or spoon to portion out the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add a tablespoon of butter.
Add 4-5 dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with additional melted butter and chopped scallions (if desired).
